## Lean 4.36.0 Machine-Checked Certificate (0 sorry, 66 Public Theorems, Dual-Agent Audited)

- Proof File: https://github.com/fabien-pierret/dcqe-postselection-ai/blob/main/lean/DCQEPostSelectionCore.lean
- Audit Record: https://github.com/fabien-pierret/dcqe-postselection-ai/blob/main/lean/AUDIT_REPORT_2_AGENTS.md
- Command: `lean lean/DCQEPostSelectionCore.lean` (Lean v4.36.0, zero external dependencies, 66/66 `#print axioms` checks report `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` only).
- Audited Scope (Deterministic rational algebraic cores over Q transferring verbatim to R; zero overclaim, zero quantum woo):
  1. Paper 1 (20 theorems): Frechet polynomial amplification law `(a_quant/a_cl)^nu = kappa^2 * C`, constant cancellation, unbounded divergence past any constant `B`, Student-t_3 leading-asymptotic witness `> 11.7x` at `C = 1000` (exact asymptotic `~ 11.747x`), exact rational Bernoulli contraction `(1 + n*u)*(1 - u)^n <= 1`, non-asymptotic collapse of both C-indexed Bonferroni (`M >= k*C`) and C-indexed Sidak (`M >= C*k`, arbitrary non-multiples) to `FPR >= 1 - eps`, exact `Q-DSR_nu` monotonicity/calibration, and strict heavy-tail under-coverage of Gaussian Q-DSR.
  2. Paper 2 (20 theorems): Bell-CHSH `|S| <= 2` on `{-1,+1}^4` and finite LHV mixtures; necessity direction of Contextuality-by-Default `|S| - 2*Delta_mismatch <= 2` on finite couplings + `|E[X] - E[Y]| <= 2*P(X != Y)`; autoregressive causal-mask Lemma 1, `Delta_0 = 2*Delta_TV`, Master Absorption Identity (Eq. 5), two-sided Corollaries 1A (`delta = 0`) & 1B (edgewise signaling dominance); exact Mobius Symmetrization Law (`S^sym = 4`, `Delta_0^sym = max(|m1|,|m3|) + max(|m2|,|m4|) < 2`, `C_CbD^sym > 2`) derived directly from forward-reverse tables; plus 4 classical rational LLM/LHV witnesses (pure signaling mirage absorbed to `2`, classical Mobius KV-cache table beating Tsirelson at `16/5 = 3.2`, polarized directed-absorbed vs. symmetrized-contextual flip, and 5-row classical LHV abstention table hitting `S_post = 10/3 > 2*sqrt(2)` yet closed to `<= 2` under `0 -> +1`).
  3. Paper 3 (26 theorems): General `K >= 2` minimax impossibility of every convex linear auditor (`delta/K <= eps0 < delta`) + strict head-to-head separation against `SIPS_infinity`; zero minimax risk & full Uniqueness Theorem of `SIPS_infinity` (with axiom satisfiability proof); Rosenbaum odds-ratio weight bracket IFF (Eq. 6) + sharp Manski-Rosenbaum Hajek IPSW bounds with vertex attainment and `Fin n` sample summation; arbitrary-dimension `(d, M)` Frobenius-Welch bound `||W^T W||_F^2 >= M^2/d`, off-diagonal cross-talk `M(M-d)/d`, quantitative max-coherence Welch bound `(M-d)/(d(M-1))`, impossibility of orthogonality for `M > d`, and exact `2x4` rational UNTF saturation; arbitrary-dimension `d` spectral Jensen concavity bound (Eq. 19) with exact isotropic equality IFF, general scalar Sherman-Morrison identity, `rho <= 1` orthonormal SNR plateau, and strict overload SNR attenuation for `rho >= 1`.
- Demarcation: Probabilistic asymptotics (Fisher-Tippett-Gnedenko, PIT, Student-t_nu integrals, Slepian), KDL (2015) sufficiency, clipped `I_col` (Eq. 7b), matrix spectral decomposition (Eq. 18), Loewner operator monotonicity for `rho <= 1`, matrix Sherman-Morrison, Markov/`erf`/Le Cam bounds (Eqs. 14-16), and 12 Python/MLX empirical suites (`sim/`) are proved analytically in the PDFs and reproduced deterministically in `sim/`.
